preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the cactus is between 1 and 5 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the cactus is between n - 1 and 5 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each node and edge ID is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The graph has no loops and multiple edges, and no edge lies on more than one simple cycle.

postconditions.description: The output is the variance of the number of connected components in the remaining graph, modulo 10^9+7.

invariants.description: The graph remains a cactus after any number of nodes are removed.
